summary.prose: Build and verify a signed Linux x86-64 daemon candidate from an exact source revision. Keep build credentials separate from signing, and require independent qualification evidence before final signing. Run task-specific tests locally as each task lands, then run the story sweep.

tasks.title: Define and verify Linux release metadata
tasks.summary: Add a Linux-only strict v1 manifest, normalized candidate identity, host requirements, canonical repo/ref channel scope, and detached Ed25519 role grants. Expose the verified subject with the digest of exact original bytes. Keep Darwin callers on their current formats.
acceptanceChecks: Reject malformed UTF-8, duplicate or unknown fields, unsafe sequence/IDs, wrong target/scope/role/key, and mismatched final lane.
Verify qualification and final grants over identical raw bytes with independent role keys.

tests.name: Linux manifest schema and digest boundaries
Role-separated Ed25519 grants and configured channel scope

tasks.title: Package the Ubuntu amd64 runtime
tasks.summary: Package the approved Node version verified against pinned upstream bytes, daemon/CLI/MCP entrypoints, Linux process broker, watchdog, dependencies and workspace runtime assets. Use safe shared staging, canonical USTAR-compatible archive output and target-specific inventory.
acceptanceChecks: Verify source commit and build host; reject missing inputs, unsafe links, unsupported ELF or ABI, and unlisted dependencies.
Relocate the archive with the shared verifier and load required native modules using the bundled Node on the documented baseline.

tests.name: Linux staging inventory, path safety and ELF dependency fixture checks
Local Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 package, relocate, verify fingerprint, load native modules and exercise required entry points

tasks.title: Add the isolated Linux candidate workflow
tasks.summary: Add a dispatchable Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 candidate workflow with read-only permissions, pinned actions, exact requested full SHA, pinned runtime and target-qualified output coordinates. Record exact run/attempt/artifact identity.
acceptanceChecks: Allow a configured full development ref without a branch-name code change. Keep production on the protected configured release ref.
Build and upload exact outputs. The job has no signing credentials, write token, or hosted test step.

tests.name: Linux workflow shape, credential isolation, exact revision and configured ref tests

tasks.title: Verify protected candidate origin and archive retrieval
tasks.summary: Implement protected fetch validation against trusted repository IDs, workflow, event, run/attempt, ref, SHA, target, artifact and expiry before reading only bounded allowed output entries. Reject duplicate and foreign assets.
acceptanceChecks: Same-version Darwin and Linux outputs remain independently addressable. Rerun, workflow, fork, ID, target and transport/inner digest mismatches fail closed.
Validate inputs and extract only named bounded members, with directory and archive safety retained.
Verify authenticated artifact transport SHA-256 or an independently recorded protected expected inner SHA-256. Candidate metadata never supplies its own trust anchor.

tests.name: GitHub origin and validated download fixtures for Linux, Darwin, rerun, substituted origin, duplicate ZIP members and digest tampering

tasks.title: Issue qualification grants and verify detached evidence
tasks.summary: Add issuer-side qualification manifest preparation and validation of independently signed local evidence against trusted required test IDs, target, ABI, exact archive origin and applicable predecessor fingerprints. Keep qualification side effects isolated.
acceptanceChecks: Verify receipt and qualification grant using independent pinned trust. Reject missing, duplicate, failed or foreign-case evidence.
Bind predecessor evidence outside the manifest to avoid a digest cycle. Fixture keys cover qualification and absence of production privileges.

tests.name: Fixture qualification grant and signed local evidence for exact artifact, host, required tests and predecessor

tasks.title: Guard final channel signing and sequence allocation
tasks.summary: Build protected final signer orchestration from exact-candidate verification and evidence checks. Serialize durable sequence allocation per repository, target, final lane and channel before releasing the detached final signature. S3 consumes this signer contract to publish. Use a protected shared sequence authority with atomic compare-and-set for independent jobs and processes.
acceptanceChecks: Recheck authenticated qualification grant, evidence, exact bytes and ref policy. No signing job executes candidate code.
Competing manifests claiming one sequence cannot both be signed. Include exact retry across interruption, scope independence, and stale/corrupt ledger refusal.
Interrupt after durable binding and before delivery and retry the exact manifest. Race independent writers and verify at most one distinct digest obtains a binding.

tests.name: Independent-writer sequence race, scoped ledger, stale and corrupt ledger, and interrupted exact retry
Final signing role, evidence and origin checks across all Linux stages using fixtures
